pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "montags" mean in the tongue twister about the mother? (1 mark)
   A. on Sundays
   B. on Mondays
   C. tomorrow
   D. every morning

2. What does "das Haus" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. house
   C. room
   D. clock

3. Why do we copy the teacher's sounds when learning German? (1 mark)
   A. To learn only spelling
   B. To make the class noisy
   C. To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   D. To avoid reading

4. Which day comes right after Montag? (1 mark)
   A. Samstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Dienstag
   D. Donnerstag

5. What does "Herzlichen Glückwunsch" express? (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. I am hungry
   C. Congratulations
   D. Goodbye

6. What does "das Ei" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. egg
   C. sugar
   D. fish

7. Which verb do you use with "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. trinken
   B. essen
   C. kochen
   D. schlafen

8. What does "der Mund" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. ear
   B. mouth
   C. face
   D. shoulder

9. What does "der Arm" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. neck
   B. arm
   C. nose
   D. finger

10. What does "der Zeh" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hand
   B. foot
   C. toe
   D. face

11. How is "z" pronounced in "Zahl"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like sh
   C. like English z
   D. like s

12. How is the letter B named in German? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. tsay
   C. ay
   D. bay

13. Which mark shows that a sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. das Ausrufezeichen (!)
   B. der Punkt (.)
   C. das Fragezeichen (?)
   D. das Komma (,)

14. What does "der Opa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. father
   B. sister
   C. family
   D. grandfather

15. What does "das Messer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. knife
   C. fork
   D. table

16. What does "Gut gemacht!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. See you soon!
   B. Be quiet!
   C. One more time!
   D. Well done!

17. What are "Anführungszeichen"? (1 mark)
   A. Full stops
   B. Hyphens
   C. Quotation marks
   D. Question marks

18. What does "März" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. July
   B. September
   C. March
   D. August

19. Which German word is the number 12? (1 mark)
   A. eins
   B. neun
   C. zwei
   D. zwölf

20. Which German word is the number 11? (1 mark)
   A. sieben
   B. sechzehn
   C. elf
   D. zwanzig

21. Which food group does "die Tomate" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Obst

22. Which little word goes with the noun "Kartoffel"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

23. What does "braune Augen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. brown eyes
   B. blue sky
   C. black hair
   D. brown shoes

24. Which adjective is made from "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. wolkin
   B. wolke
   C. wolken
   D. wolkig

25. What does "hinter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. behind
   C. next to
   D. in front of

26. Which German word or phrase means "no"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Auf Wiedersehen
   C. Sehr gut
   D. Nein

27. Which greeting is correctly written and punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. Guten Morgen, Amina!
   B. guten morgen amina
   C. Guten morgen amina.
   D. Gutten Morgen, Amina!

28. Which German word or phrase means "uncle"? (1 mark)
   A. der Bruder
   B. der Onkel
   C. die Familie
   D. die Eltern

29. What does "schwimmen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to speak
   B. to swim
   C. to sing
   D. to have a shower

30. Which German word means "to learn or study"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. sprechen
   B. lesen
   C. lernen
   D. tanzen

31. Which German word or phrase means "Monday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Montag
   B. der Sonntag
   C. der Samstag
   D. der Donnerstag

32. What does "der vierte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fifth
   B. sixth
   C. third
   D. fourth

33. What does "der siebte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eighth
   B. seventh
   C. first
   D. second

34. Which German word means "May"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. Mai
   B. November
   C. September
   D. Januar

35. Which little word goes with the noun "Käse"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

36. Which food group does "die Milch" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Obst
   B. das Gemüse
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Fleisch

37. Which word completes "Ich habe ___ Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. einem
   B. einen
   C. ein
   D. eine

38. Which German word or phrase means "arm"? (1 mark)
   A. der Arm
   B. die Nase
   C. das Knie
   D. der Kopf

39. Which verb goes with "Die Sonne ___"? (1 mark)
   A. weht
   B. schneit
   C. regnet
   D. scheint

40. Which German word means "warm"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. nass
   B. warm
   C. neblig
   D. wolkig

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

43. Complete with the correct verb form: "Mutter ___ (kochen). Vater ___ (lesen). Der Hund ___ (schlafen)." (3 marks)

44. Unscramble and write with der, die or das: NUMD and ESAN. (4 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

46. Write in German: "Who is that? That is my mother." (2 marks)

47. Say the three time words heute, morgen and gestern in English and give one German sentence with one of them. (3 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)

49. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

50. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)

51. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

52. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)

53. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

54. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

55. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)

57. Write the German words with der, die or das for: radio, nose, family. (3 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sky, cooker. (2 marks)

59. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bed, birthday, banana. (3 marks)

60. Write the German words with their articles for: fridge, cooker, plate, spoon. (4 marks)

61. Say why the word "Schlafzimmer" is a das word. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — on Mondays
   Montags means on Mondays, or every Monday.

2. B — house
   das Haus means house.

3. C — To learn the sounds accurately by practice
   Imitation trains the ears and mouth to make the new sounds.

4. C — Dienstag
   After Montag comes Dienstag.

5. C — Congratulations
   It is a warm congratulation or best wish.

6. B — egg
   das Ei means egg.

7. A — trinken
   We drink water.

8. B — mouth
   der Mund means mouth.

9. B — arm
   der Arm means arm.

10. C — toe
   der Zeh means toe.

11. A — like ts
   German z sounds like ts.

12. D — bay
   In German the letter B is called bay.

13. C — das Fragezeichen (?)
   The question mark is das Fragezeichen.

14. D — grandfather
   der Opa means grandfather.

15. B — knife
   das Messer means knife.

16. D — Well done!
   Gut gemacht is praise.

17. C — Quotation marks
   They show the words someone says.

18. C — March
   März means March.

19. D — zwölf
   12 in German is zwölf.

20. C — elf
   11 in German is elf.

21. A — das Gemüse
   die Tomate belongs to das Gemüse.

22. D — die
   It is die Kartoffel, so the little word is die.

23. A — brown eyes
   braun = brown and Augen = eyes.

24. D — wolkig
   Wolke + -ig gives wolkig, cloudy.

25. B — behind
   hinter means behind.

26. D — Nein
   no in German is Nein.

27. A — Guten Morgen, Amina!
   Capital letters for the first word, the noun and the name, and a mark at the end.

28. B — der Onkel
   uncle in German is der Onkel.

29. B — to swim
   schwimmen means to swim.

30. C — lernen
   to learn or study in German is lernen.

31. A — der Montag
   Monday in German is der Montag.

32. D — fourth
   der vierte means fourth.

33. B — seventh
   der siebte means seventh.

34. A — Mai
   May in German is Mai.

35. C — der
   It is der Käse, so the little word is der.

36. C — die Getränke
   die Milch belongs to die Getränke.

37. D — eine
   Nase is a die word, so we say eine.

38. A — der Arm
   arm in German is der Arm.

39. D — scheint
   Die Sonne scheint means the sun shines.

40. B — warm
   warm in German is warm.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: kocht, liest, schläft.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb form.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Mund and die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wer ist das? Das ist meine Mutter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: heute = today, morgen = tomorrow, gestern = yesterday. For example: Heute ist Montag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the three meanings, 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for capital letters.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Radio, die Nase, die Familie.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Himmel, der Herd.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Bett, der Geburtstag, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Kühlschrank, der Herd, der Teller, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: Its last part, Zimmer, is a das word, and a joined word takes the article of the last part.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for last part, 1 mark for Zimmer being das.
